title: 模组支持不足且更新破坏模组生态
description: 游戏缺乏原生模组支持，模组安装困难，且频繁更新导致模组环境重置或失效。
evidence: anything beyond simple .json remixes require third-party loaders, and the developers, being extreme fence-sitters, have not forbidden mods with custom assemblies but has forbidden mods from loading their own assemblies
its modding scene is essentially soft-reset every time a new patch is released, which is OFTEN
the workshop isn't very useful and you have to get some files from GitHub to mod the game files yourself. And even then they probably wont work

evidence_items.quote: the developer also decided to make native workshop support as much of a backburner issue as his core gameplay loop
evidence_items.description: 开发者没有优先考虑原生创意工坊支持，导致模组安装困难。
evidence_items.quote_zh: 开发者还决定把原生创意工坊支持也当成和核心玩法循环一样靠后的问题来处理

evidence_items.quote: its modding scene is essentially soft-reset every time a new patch is released, which is OFTEN
evidence_items.description: 每次补丁发布都会重置mod环境
evidence_items.quote_zh: 每次发布新补丁，它的模组社区基本上都会被软重置，而补丁发布得还非常频繁

evidence_items.quote: the workshop isn't very useful and you have to get some files from GitHub to mod the game files yourself. And even then they probably wont work
evidence_items.description: 创意工坊无用，需手动从GitHub获取文件且可能无效
evidence_items.quote_zh: 创意工坊不是很有用，你必须从GitHub上获取一些文件才能自己修改游戏文件。而且即便如此，它们很可能也不会起作用

evidence_items.quote: 游戏更新太频繁了，导致mod生态不好
evidence_items.description: 游戏更新过于频繁，影响mod生态
evidence_items.quote_zh: 游戏更新太频繁了，导致mod生态不好

evidence_items.quote: anything beyond simple .json remixes require third-party loaders, and the developers, being extreme fence-sitters, have not forbidden mods with custom assemblies but has forbidden mods from loading their own assemblies
evidence_items.description: 模组支持有限，自定义程序集受限
evidence_items.quote_zh: 任何超出简单 .json 混搭的东西都需要第三方加载器，而开发者们，作为极端的骑墙派，没有禁止带有自定义程序集的模组，但禁止了模组加载它们自己的程序集
